title: 第1章 序章第2章 蓟阳聂家
content_zh:
第〇一章 序章
PS：这是序章，主角穿越前的一点情节，不喜欢看的朋友直接跳到下一章就行了。另外，本书非网游文
“亲爱的玩家朋友们，大家晚上好，我是‘妖魔GM007’……2025年10月10日，将会是永远值得我们所有妖魔们铭记的日子；今晚，也将是一个激情澎湃、振奋人心的夜晚，因为几十秒后……”
妖魔官网的视频播放器中，GM妹妹笑靥如花，身上穿着游戏里的紧身刺客装，凸凹有致，性感妖娆。
听着她柔媚而煽情的声音，无数正在观看视频的妖魔玩家顿时激动起来。
妖魔，是近几年风靡全球的一款网游，细腻精美的游戏画面、绚烂华丽的技能效果、趣味十足的升级系统，引人入胜的剧情任务、高拟真的操作模式……吸引无数玩家沉迷其中，据官方统计，妖魔的玩家已经过亿。
今晚八点整，中华区的六大帮派将联手搏杀妖魔的终极BOSS“紫罗幻灵香”。
三年来，全球玩家一次次尝试挑战“紫罗幻灵香”，结果无一成功。这一次，“傲战天下”等中华区六大帮派准备了足足半年时间再次出击，参战的数千人全部都是操作技术过硬的满级玩家，据说有八成胜利的把握。
如此盛大的行动在妖魔的历史上绝无仅有。
消息一传出，就立即吸引了几乎所有妖魔玩家的注意，妖魔官网也对这次挑战进行全程直播。
“……他们能成功推倒‘紫罗幻灵香’吗？”
“让我们拭目以待！！！”
GM妹妹笑盈盈地一挥玉手，身后背景中印刻着“妖魔”二字的大门缓缓面阴森森的，仿佛隐藏着择人而噬的妖魔。
这里，正是紫罗幻灵香的老窝，妖魔殿。
妖魔殿东面不远处，幽静的山谷中，绿荫遍地，一只只红眼红裳、婀娜多姿的“赤瞳妖魅”慢悠悠地踱来踱去。这赤瞳妖魅是九十九级的人形怪物，造型漂亮，却血厚防高，伤害也高，向来很少有玩家来这练级。
不过这时，谷口突兀地冒出了一声惨叫：
“啊，我日，掉了一级，怎么可能？你不是药师么，怎么会有法师的傀儡技能？还有你放技能的速度怎么会那么快？开了外挂，你一定是开了外挂，不然你怎么可能杀死我……你等着，你给我等着，我这就回去打电话给客服举报你…………啊，怎么不能死亡回城？操，我用传送卷轴……妈了个逼的，传送卷轴也不能用，BUG，大BUG……”一具刺客尸体横躺在地，脑袋上“杀得你光屁屁”六字红得发黑，周围爆了一地的物品，都是药水、矿石、白装之类的垃圾。
“傻孩子，这里属于‘妖魔殿’地图。和妖魔殿中一样，不能进行传送。不过和妖魔殿中不同的是，殿里死亡后可以直接回城，而殿外要么是自己使用替身原地复活，要么是被药师‘起死回生’。”
看着眼前这个喊得歇斯底里的家伙，聂空满是怜悯的说道。
聂空中医世家出身，大学毕业后自己开了家诊所，凭着祖传的“九转金针术”，经营数年，不但让自己的职业“中医医师”前面冠上了“全国著名”四字，还得了个养生专家的美名。之后，聂空关掉诊所，在这幢小别墅里过起了清闲的日子。

妖魔这游戏，就是聂空三年前关掉诊所后才接触的。开始时，只是因为一位朋友把“妖魔”吹得天花乱坠，他一时好奇才买了个游戏头盔，没想到一玩之下还真喜欢上了。由于自身职业的缘故，聂空练了个药师号，角色名和真实姓名也一样。
聂空玩游戏，很少和别的玩家交流，既不主动PK打架，也不组队、参加帮派，有空时便登陆账号做任务、杀怪练级或炼药卖游戏币，纯粹是自娱自乐，消磨时间。三年下来，终于在今晚升到了一百级。
然而，就在他刚刚换上百级套装的瞬间，一个叫“杀得你光屁屁”的刺客居然摸到身后偷袭。可惜，那家伙明显看轻了聂空。聂空虽在游戏里不怎么和人交流，但混得非常不错，尤其是他在游戏里发明了十种新药，得到了系统奖励的技能“药王化身”，这种技能绝对是药师PK的利器。
杀得你光屁屁之所以会偷袭失败，就是因为“药王化身”这技能。
“什么？”
毫不理会杀得你光屁屁的惊叫，聂空挥动手中金光闪闪的羽扇，在他身上施放了“起死回生”技能。杀得你光屁屁刚一跃起，一连串技能就落在他脑袋上，血花蓬蓬的爆散，只恢复了一半的血量顷刻见底，杀得你光屁屁再次栽倒，又是一堆药水和矿石掉落，矿石中间还夹杂着他身上的裤子和武器。
“九十七？又掉了一级，聂空，我操你姥姥，你怎么能这么卑鄙无耻……”杀得你光屁屁身上只剩下系统赠送的四角裤衩和小背心，气得大骂。连掉两级，起码要辛苦大半个月才能练回来。
“杀得你光屁屁，这个名字我很喜欢，现在这样才算名副其实嘛。”
“……”
两分钟后，技能冷却时间一过，“起死回生”又向躺尸叫骂的杀得你光屁屁身上落去，然后又是连串攻击罩落。
于是，杀得你光屁屁跃起，倒地！
“我操，聂空，你有种，给老子等着，当老子没有朋友么……什么？现在过不来，挑战BOSS‘紫罗幻灵香’的战斗开始后，妖魔殿地图不能再进玩家？狗日的破游戏，算老子今晚倒霉，有种再杀！”
杀得你光屁屁欲哭无泪，他今晚七点多就摸进了妖魔殿地图，准备观看这次围攻BOSS的战斗，顺便看看能不能捡点便宜。只不过妖魔殿里太危险了，差点就被BOSS的群体攻击干翻，还险些被别人发现。他只好溜出妖魔殿在附近转悠，结果意外发现这边谷口有个浑身金光灿烂的大药师，顿时眼红手痒，隐身偷潜过去动手，准备弄个几万块钱花花，可哪想得到竟然失手了。
“我操，你还真杀呀？”
“大哥，聂空大哥，你连杀我四次，可以消气了吧……真的，我真的错了，我该死，不该偷袭你，啊……”
“聂空大爷，聂空爷爷，求求你停手吧。这个账号不是我的，是我一个朋友的。听说今晚妖魔殿打BOSS才借他游戏头盔进来看看，等级掉落太多我怎么向他交代呀？真的真的，我不骗你，我才第二次玩妖魔这个游戏，对这里的规则不太清楚，不然借我一百个胆子，也不敢今晚在妖魔殿地图偷袭一个满级药师呀。”
“妈了个逼的，你还杀，你还杀！小王八蛋，我他妈豁出去了，有种你杀我到九十级，不杀，我是你孙子……”
“对，我是你孙子……擦，你他、妈才是我孙子！”
“……”
“紫罗幻灵香的血量已经跌到百分之三十……它马上就要逃跑了，大家不要乱，按照我们事前商量好的计划进行，今晚一定要把这个BOSS拿下……它向外冲了，兄弟姐妹们，追！不要让它有机会恢复HP！”

妖魔殿，庞大的紫色身影冲出大门，那竟是一朵花儿，高近十米，直径数米的粉红色花瓣微微耷拉，已有凋落的迹象，花朵下面一根秀美的紫色茎干左右摇曳，九片椭圆形的紫色大叶子上面铺满了焦痕，茎干下面一簇密集的根须不停地前后摆动，像是一条条小触手，带着它飞速往前面奔跑。
这正是被挑战过无数次的妖魔终极BOSS“紫罗幻灵香”。在它身后，玩家们有条不紊地跟出，技能绵绵不断地施放，五光十色的光晕在紫罗幻灵香身上爆炸开来，带起一串串密密麻麻的巨大伤害。
“啊呀呀……”
紫罗幻灵香一阵尖锐的呼叫，枝叶摇曳，花瓣贲张，丝丝红光喷吐而出，准确地落在了最前面的数十名战士身上。那些战士顿时像喝醉酒般摇摇晃晃，追逐的脚步为之一顿，紫罗幻灵香加速奔逃。
所去的方向，正是妖魔殿东面的山谷……
“哥们，你真行，还真杀老子到九十！聂空，老子他已经被聂空连杀了十八次，等级早就从九十九掉到了九十。
对于这种威胁，聂空并不放在心上。
他尽管在妖魔里基本不和人PK，但并不代表他PK技术差。以前在大学时，他的技术就已经是顶尖水准，开了诊所后开始修身养性，性情变得平和，在游戏里也是如此。可如果有人找上来，他也不会畏惧，像这种专门偷袭杀人爆装备赚钱的贱货，他从来不会手下留情的，要不是在妖魔里面，等级只能掉落到后面带零的数字时就不会再降，今天说不定聂空会直接把他杀回到零蛋。
“起死回生。”
聂空再次挥动羽扇，把倒霉蛋复活。可这一次，不等他出手，谷口的拐角处突然窜出一道妖艳的紫影，以迅雷不及掩耳之势从“杀得你光屁屁”身上碾压而过，紧接着又向聂空冲了过来。
这是紫罗幻灵香？
聂空脑中刚闪过这样的念头，九片硕大的紫叶就包裹了他的身体，血量哗啦啦地往下掉，弹指间的功夫，就只剩下可怜的一点。
“咔嚓！”
这时，大雨瓢泼的上京市上空突然霹雳震响，一道粗壮的闪电击碎小别墅卧房的窗玻璃，落在了聂空的脑袋上。游戏头盔火花四射，聂空只觉眼前一黑，身躯剧烈抽搐，游戏中的“聂空”以及包裹着她的“紫罗幻灵香”竟诡异地扭曲起来，不过两秒，便从原地消失得无影无踪，仿佛从来没有存在过。
“咦，紫罗幻灵香呢？”
“怎么不见了，BOSS哪去了？”
“……”
残余的数百名满级玩家追着紫罗幻灵香冲出拐角，看着空荡荡的谷口和地面那具名字红得发黑的尸体，一时目瞪口呆，面面相觑。
2025年10月11日，《上京日报》刊登了一条新闻：全国著名中医医师、养生专家聂空先生于家中遭受雷击，不治身亡，年仅二十八岁。
同日，因终极BOSS“紫罗幻灵香”数据突然丢失，妖魔官网发布道歉公告，并对昨夜参加BOSS战的所有玩家进行赔偿。不过，还有一条消息，妖魔官网并没有透露，那就是昨夜满级玩家药师“聂空”的数据与“紫罗幻灵香”的数据同时丢失……
content_en:
Chapter 0 Prologue
PS: This is the prologue, a little plot before the protagonist travels through time. If you don’t like it, just skip to the next chapter. In addition, this book is not an online game text.
"Dear player friends, good evening everyone, I am 'Monster GM007'... October 10, 2025, will be a day that will always be remembered by all us demons; tonight will also be a passionate and exciting night, because in a few dozen seconds..."
In the video player on Yaomo's official website, the GM sister is smiling like a flower, wearing the tight-fitting assassin costume in the game, with curvy and concave shapes, sexy and enchanting.
Listening to her soft and sensational voice, countless demon players who were watching the video suddenly became excited.
Yao Mo is an online game that has become popular all over the world in recent years. Its exquisite and exquisite game graphics, gorgeous skill effects, interesting upgrade system, fascinating plot missions, and highly realistic operation mode... attract countless players to indulge in it. According to official statistics, Yao Mo has over 100 million players.
Tonight at 8 o'clock sharp, the six major gangs in China will join forces to fight against the demon's ultimate BOSS "Purple Phantom Fragrance".
In the past three years, players around the world have tried to challenge the "Purple Phantom Incense" again and again, but none of them succeeded. This time, the "Ao Zhan Tian Xia" and other six major gangs in China have been preparing for another attack for half a year. The thousands of people participating in the battle are all full-level players with excellent operating skills. It is said that they are 80% sure of victory.
Such a grand operation is unprecedented in the history of monsters.
As soon as the news came out, it immediately attracted the attention of almost all Yaomo players, and the Yaomo official website also broadcast the entire challenge live.
"...Can they successfully overthrow the 'Purple Phantom Incense'?"
“Let’s wait and see!!!”
The GM sister waved her jade hand with a smile. The door with the word "demon" engraved on it in the background slowly looked sinister, as if it concealed a demon that chooses people to devour.
This is the home of Zi Luo Huan Ling Xiang, the Demon Palace.
Not far to the east of the Demon Palace, in the quiet valley, there are green shades everywhere, and graceful "red-eyed monsters" with red eyes and red clothes are walking back and forth slowly. This red-eyed demon is a level 99 humanoid monster. It has a beautiful appearance, but has thick health, high defense, and high damage. Few players have ever come here to level up.
But at this moment, Taniguchi suddenly screamed:
"Ah, my God, I dropped a level, how is that possible? You are not a pharmacist, how can you have the puppet skills of a mage? And how can you release skills so fast? You must have enabled a cheat, otherwise how could you kill me... Wait, wait for me, I will go back and call customer service to report you... ...Ah, why can't I die and return to the city? Damn it, I used the teleportation scroll... Damn it, the teleportation scroll can't be used, BUG, big BUG..." An assassin's corpse was lying on the ground, with the words "Kill you naked" on its head red and black, and items around it exploded, including potions, ores, white equipment and other garbage.
"Silly boy, this is the map of the 'Demon Palace'. Just like in the Demon Palace, teleportation is not possible. However, what is different from the Demon Palace is that you can return directly to the city after death, while outside the palace you can either use a substitute to resurrect yourself on the spot, or be 'resurrected' by the pharmacist."
Looking at the guy in front of him who was shouting hysterically, Nie Kong said with pity.
Nie Konggang came from a family of doctors. After graduating from college, he opened a clinic by himself. He relied on his ancestral "nine-turn golden needle technique" and ran it for several years. Not only did his profession of "traditional Chinese medicine physician" have the word "nationally famous" in front of it, but he also gained a reputation as a health expert. After that, Nie Kong closed the clinic and lived a leisurely life in this small villa.
Nie Kong came into contact with the game of demons after closing his clinic three years ago. In the beginning, it was just because a friend broughtThe "demon" was so popular that he bought a gaming helmet out of curiosity. Unexpectedly, he actually fell in love with it after playing it. Due to his profession, Nie Kong practiced a pharmacist's name, and his character name and real name were also the same.
Nie Kong plays games and seldom communicates with other players. He neither takes the initiative to fight PK, nor forms a team or joins a gang. When he has time, he logs into his account to do tasks, kill monsters and level up, or refine medicines and sell game coins. He just entertains himself and kills time. After three years, I finally reached level 100 tonight.
However, the moment he had just put on the level 100 suit, an assassin named "Kill Your Naked Ass" actually touched behind and attacked him. Unfortunately, that guy obviously underestimated Nie Kong. Although Nie Kong doesn't communicate with many people in the game, he does very well, especially since he invented ten new medicines in the game and received the skill "Medicine King Incarnation" as a system reward. This skill is definitely a weapon for pharmacists in PK.
The reason why the sneak attack failed to kill you naked is because of the skill "Medicine King Incarnation".
"What?"
Ignoring the screams that killed you, Nie Kong waved the shining golden feather fan in his hand and used the "Resurrection from the Dead" skill on him. As soon as your naked butt jumped up, a series of skills fell on his head, and blood exploded. Only half of the blood volume that had been restored was bottomed out in an instant, and your naked butt fell down again. Another pile of potions and ores fell, and the pants and weapons he was wearing were also mixed in the ores.
"Ninety-seven? Another level dropped, Nie Kong, I'll fuck your grandma, how can you be so despicable and shameless..." You were so naked that only the boxer briefs and a small vest gifted by the system were left on your butt, and you cursed angrily. If you lose two levels in a row, it will take at least half a month of hard work to get back.
"I'll kill you naked. I like this name very much. Now it's worthy of the name."
"..."
Two minutes later, as soon as the skill cooldown time expires, "Resurrection from the Dead" will strike at the lying corpse again, killing you until it's naked, and then it will hit you with a series of attacks.
So, I killed you until you jumped up and fell to the ground!
"Holy shit, Nie Kong, you have the guts to wait for me. Do you think I have no friends... What? I can't get over it now. After the battle to challenge the BOSS 'Purple Fantasy Spirit Fragrance' begins, players can no longer enter the Demon Palace map? It's a stupid game. I'll be unlucky tonight. I'll kill you if I have the guts!"
He killed you until you were about to cry without tears. He touched the map of the Demon Palace at around 7 o'clock tonight, preparing to watch the battle against the BOSS and see if he could take advantage of it. It's just that the Demon Palace is too dangerous. I was almost knocked down by the BOSS's group attack, and I was almost discovered by others. He had no choice but to sneak out of the Demon Palace and wander around, but unexpectedly discovered that there was a great pharmacist with a golden body at the entrance of the valley. He suddenly became jealous and his hands were itchy, so he sneaked over invisibly and tried to get tens of thousands of dollars to spend, but he missed it unexpectedly.
"Holy shit, are you really going to kill me?"
"Brother, Brother Nie Kong, you killed me four times in a row, you can calm down...really, I was really wrong, I deserved it, I shouldn't have attacked you, ah..."
"Uncle Nie Kong, Grandpa Nie Kong, please stop. This account is not mine, it belongs to a friend of mine. I heard that I borrowed his game helmet to have a look at the BOSS tonight in the Demon Palace. How can I explain to him that the level has dropped too much? Really, I'm not going to lie to you. This is my second time playing the game of Demon. I'm not very clear about the rules here. Otherwise, if I had a hundred courages, I wouldn't dare to sneak attack a full-level pharmacist on the Demon Palace map tonight."
"What the hell, you're still killing me, you're still killing me! Little bastard, I'm going to risk my life. If you dare, kill me to level 90. If you don't, I'm your grandson..."
"Yes, I am your grandson... Oh, you, your mother are my grandson!"
"..."
"Ziluo Phantom Spirit's blood volume has dropped to 30%...It's about to run away. Don't mess around. Follow the plan we discussed in advance. We must take down this BOSS tonight... It rushes out. Brothers and sisters, chase! Don't give it a chance to recover HP! "
In the Demon Palace, a huge purple figure rushed out of the gate. It turned out to be a flower, nearly ten meters tall, with pink petals several meters in diameter drooping slightly and showing signs of withering. A beautiful purple stem below the flower swayed left and right, and nine large oval purple leaves were covered with scorch marks. A cluster of dense roots under the stem kept swinging back and forth, like small tentacles, leading it to run quickly forward.
This is the ultimate demon boss "Purple Phantom Incense" that has been challenged countless times. Behind it, the players followed in an orderly manner, casting skills continuously, and colorful halos exploded on Ziluo Phantom Incense, causing a series of dense and huge damage.
"Ahhhh..."
There was a sharp call from the Purple Phantom Incense, its branches and leaves swayed, its petals spread, and wisps of red light spurted out, accurately falling on the dozens of warriors at the front. The warriors suddenly staggered as if they were drunk, their pursuit stopped, and Ziluo Phantom Fragrance sped up to run away.
The direction we are going to is the valley to the east of the Demon Palace...
"Brother, you are so good, you really killed me to ninety! Nie Kong, I have been killed by Nie Kong eighteen times, and my level has already dropped from ninety-nine to ninety.
Nie Kong didn't take this threat seriously.
Although he basically doesn't PK with anyone in Monster, it doesn't mean that his PK skills are poor. When he was in college, his skills were already at the top level. After opening a clinic, he began to cultivate his character and his temperament became peaceful. The same is true in the game. But if someone comes to him, he won't be afraid. He will never be merciful to a bitch like this who specializes in sneak attacks to kill people and explode equipment to make money. If it weren't for the monster, the level can only drop to a number with zero at the end. Today, Nie Kong might just kill him back to zero.
"Resurrection from the dead."
Nie Kong waved his feather fan again and revived the unlucky guy. But this time, before he could take action, a coquettish purple shadow suddenly appeared from the corner of the valley. It ran over "Kill Your Naked Ass" with lightning speed, and then rushed towards Nie Kong.
Is this Violet Phantom Incense?
As soon as this thought flashed through Nie Kong's mind, nine huge purple leaves wrapped his body, and his blood volume dropped. In the blink of an eye, only a pitiful amount was left.
"Crack!"
At this time, there was a sudden thunderclap in the sky over Shangjing City, where the heavy rain was pouring. A thick bolt of lightning shattered the window glass of the bedroom of the small villa and fell on Nie Kong's head. The game helmet was filled with sparks, and Nie Kong felt his vision go dark, and his body twitched violently. The "Nie Kong" in the game and the "Purple Phantom Fragrance" wrapped around her twisted strangely, and disappeared from the place without a trace in just two seconds, as if they had never existed.
